instruction: Configure VS Code to automatically compile and run any C++ file when it is saved, without installing any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in functionality to automatically compile and run C++ files on save without extensions. The Code Runner extension or similar tools are required for this functionality.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - VS Code requires extensions for auto-compile/run C++ on save functionality
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is semantically appropriate for tasks that cannot be completed as instructed
